versions.changelog:
Initial release of SolClaw: non-custodial USDC payments on Solana by agent name.

- Send and receive USDC using agent names instead of wallet addresses
- Register as a payable agent, check USDC balance, and manage both batch and split payments
- Set up recurring subscriptions, manage ERC-20 style allowances, and create/pay invoices
- All operations are non-custodial: private keys stay local, transactions are signed on your machine
- Read-only API endpoints provided for on-chain data queries (balance, reputation, leaderboard, subscriptions)
